summary: Both fixes confirmed for what each claims. ext.apply_rep_pens with rep_p 1.5 on a -inf logit inside the penalty window (factor 1) and a -inf logit outside it (factor 0): at 3c801c61b014 (parent of the partial fix) both became NaN. At the partial fix a65386545773 the factor-0 case stayed -inf but the factor-1 case was still NaN, matching its 'partial' status; the same held at a5caa423bbd9 (parent of the second fix). At 43383ebdbcc2 both stayed -inf. The finite control logit 2.0 in the window was penalized to 1.3333 at every commit. The harness labels the partial-fix row stated_behaviour because factor 1 is still NaN; the outcome is set by hand to credit each fix with its claimed case.
what_ran: repro.py calls the extension's apply_rep_pens (the kernel SS_RepP uses) directly on physical GPU 1 with float32 logits of shape (1, 1024), past_ids [5, 10, 30, 7], rep_p 1.5, sustain_range 64, decay_range 0, and inspects tokens 10 (-inf, in window), 20 (-inf, not in window) and 30 (2.0, in window).
